subject: Burnout 3 Takedown save issues
author: Xandu
body:
Unfortunately not all Burnout players are BurnoutAholics like us and don’t have the skill to win with one of the slower cars. As for locking… well there is always someone that wants to use one of the special cars and locking to that class is really not an alternative and then you would have to lock to super or one of the lower classes and the special car people would not be happy…and we can’t have that can we?

Anyway... I think it is possible to enjoy the game without all the cars but it does make it hard to recruit new players when all they get to choose from is one car in each class.

-- BurnoutAholics.com admin --

subject: The death of Burnout 3 Takedown!
author: Xandu
body:
I think Burnout 3 Takedown is dying slowly... The main problem with the game is that you have to complete the game offline to unlock cars to be able to play online. Every time your Xbox has to be sent back for repair or has to be replaced you have to complete the game again. If we were able to copy and backup our save games for the game this would be no problem at all. As you all probably know this is not possible for Burnout 3 Takedown. The save game is locked to some hardware key and this key seems to change when the most common problems with the Xbox is fixed. I love Burnout 3 Takedown but I’m not going to start completing the game for the 10th time... and that means I’m not going to be playing it online. It's a great game but not that great!
To keep the game alive a patch needs to be made that unlocks all the cars for online play. But I don't think that will happen because EA probably want to shutdown the servers ASAP because it cannot be good business keeping these servers running! Right?

-- BurnoutAholics.com admin --
